groups.activity: bounties and Ticker trades toward Doer

rows.label: Debt-Bonds
rows.note: Training, Shelter and Medical bonds; exact counts per rank not itemized here
rows.alt: Ticker sells cheap Training/Shelter bonds for credits and materials

rows.label: Shelter Debt-Bond
rows.note: spent again at the gild, separate from rank-up costs

conditions: Update 35.1 (Feb 2024) cut rank-up bond costs to a fraction of their old values; Update 36.0 moved bounty bond drops to the final stage and halved Ticker's credit costs.
bonuses: Profit-Taker always drops 3 Medical, 2 Advances and 1 Familial bond per run once it's available.

groups.activity: buy chamber, grip and loader blueprints

rows.label: Slap Blueprint
rows.note: loader, Rank 0; standing cost not confirmed in sources

conditions: Grip and loader give no Mastery. The classic secondary build swaps in Haymaker (Outworlder) and Splat (Cove), but that build isn't needed for the chamber's Mastery.

groups.sub: crates by the Fortuna exit, ponds for fish

rows.label: Thermal Sludge
rows.note: round-topped Corpus containers around Vallis camps; also bounty rewards

rows.label: Axidrol Alloy
rows.note: refine from Axidite ore; one craft yields 20

rows.label: Tink Dissipator Coil
rows.note: 1 per Tink servofish, Vallis ponds, Cold weather only

conditions: Axidrol Alloy's reusable blueprint costs 1,000 standing from Smokefinger, Rank 0.
Tink only bite during the Vallis's Cold cycle (about 22 minutes Cold to 4 Warm), the opposite window from Kriller and Eye-Eye.
bonuses: Thermal Sludge crates respawn after you move 200-250 m away and come back, so two nearby crate clusters can be looped.

groups.activity: build, assemble, level, gild, level again

rows.label: gild at rank 30
rows.note: Doer rank, 10 Shelter Debt-Bonds, 5,000 credits; resets it to rank 0

conditions: An ungilded Kitgun earns no Mastery no matter how far it's levelled. Level to 30, gild, then level to 30 again.
Only one Tombfinger ever counts for Mastery; primary and secondary share the entry.
